import gzip
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

root = Path('/home/moloch/jacobian-lens/research/refit_round_2026-09-07/probe_extension')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('p4_workflow', root / 'workflow.py')
w = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(w)
plan = w.load_plan(root / 'prepared/plan.json')
self_test = w.read_json(root / 'SELF_TEST.json')
tokenizer_test = w.read_json(root / 'TOKENIZER_PREFLIGHT.json')
w.require(self_test['status'] == 'PASS_SYNTHETIC_CPU_ONLY' and self_test['checks_count'] == 128, 'final self-test proof')
w.require(tokenizer_test['status'] == 'PASS_LOCAL_TOKENIZER_ONLY' and len(tokenizer_test['encoded']) == 1224, 'actual tokenizer proof')
for evidence in [self_test, tokenizer_test]:
    w.check_identity(root / 'workflow.py', evidence['implementation'])
    w.check_identity(root / 'CONTRACT.md', evidence['contract'])
w.check_identity(root / 'prepared/plan.json', tokenizer_test['plan'])
payload = w.fresh_dir(root / 'payload')
(payload / 'prepared').mkdir()
names = ['CONTRACT.md', 'workflow.py', 'prepared/plan.json', 'prepared/prompts.json', 'prepared/model_manifest.json', 'prepared/historical_provenance.json']
files = []
for name in names:
    source = root / name
    target = payload / name
    with target.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(source.read_bytes())
    w.check_identity(target, w.identity(source))
    files.append({'relative': name, 'sha256': w.digest(target), 'size': target.stat().st_size, 'source': w.identity(source)})
command = [sys.executable, '-B', str(payload / 'workflow.py'), 'validate', '--plan', str(payload / 'prepared/plan.json')]
validated = subprocess.run(command, check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
w.require(validated.stdout.strip() == 'VALID', 'relocated payload validation')
archive = root / 'payload.tar.gz'
with archive.open('xb') as output:
    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=output, filename='', mode='wb', mtime=0) as compressed:
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=compressed, mode='w', format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as packed:
            for record in files:
                body = (payload / record['relative']).read_bytes()
                entry = tarfile.TarInfo(record['relative'])
                entry.size = len(body)
                entry.mode = 0o644
                entry.mtime = 0
                entry.uid = entry.gid = 0
                entry.uname = entry.gname = ''
                packed.addfile(entry, io.BytesIO(body))
with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as packed:
    entries = packed.getmembers()
    w.require([entry.name for entry in entries] == names, 'exact six-member archive')
    for entry, record in zip(entries, files, strict=True):
        w.require(entry.isfile() and not entry.issym() and not entry.islnk(), 'regular payload file')
        body = packed.extractfile(entry).read()
        w.require(len(body) == record['size'] and hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == record['sha256'], 'archive bytes match source')
manifest = {
    'schema': 'p4-payload-manifest-v1', 'status': 'PREPARED_LOCAL_ONLY', 'created_utc': w.utc(),
    'files': files, 'file_count': len(files), 'uncompressed_file_bytes': sum(record['size'] for record in files),
    'archive': w.identity(archive), 'archive_layout': 'Paths relative to the intended P4 extraction directory; six regular files only.',
    'relocated_validation': {'command': command, 'returncode': validated.returncode, 'stdout': validated.stdout, 'stderr': validated.stderr},
    'excluded': ['historical feature arrays', 'model weights and tokenizer files', 'credentials', 'local proofs', 'classifier dependencies'],
}
w.write_json(root / 'PAYLOAD_MANIFEST.json', manifest)
proof = {
    'schema': 'p4-preparation-proof-v1', 'status': 'PASS_PREPARATION_ONLY_NO_SCIENTIFIC_EXECUTION', 'created_utc': w.utc(),
    'contract': w.identity(root / 'CONTRACT.md'), 'implementation': w.identity(root / 'workflow.py'), 'readme': w.identity(root / 'README.md'),
    'self_test': w.identity(root / 'SELF_TEST.json'), 'self_test_checks': self_test['checks_count'],
    'tokenizer_preflight': w.identity(root / 'TOKENIZER_PREFLIGHT.json'),
    'prepared_files': [w.identity(root / name) for name in names if name.startswith('prepared/')],
    'payload_manifest': w.identity(root / 'PAYLOAD_MANIFEST.json'), 'payload_archive': w.identity(archive),
    'historical_inputs': plan['inputs'], 'current_source_pins': plan['source_pins'],
    'unused_historical_source_differences': plan['unused_historical_source_differences'],
    'preparation_false_refusal_fix': 'Historical evaluate.py was previously compared to current bytes despite not being consumed. Preparation retains the exact archived provenance bytes and explicitly records its old/current hashes; every declared current source pin and consumed dependency identity remains enforced.',
    'population': {'prompts': 1224, 'old_rows': 648, 'new_rows': 576, 'new_unordered_pairs': 36, 'folds': 5, 'eligible_rows': 576, 'eligible_unordered_pairs': 39, 'retained_draws': 20000},
    'validated': ['all eight literal historical artifact hashes', 'all nine current source pins', 'original CV ancestry, labels, pair folds, fixed layer/C choices and eligible mask', 'all 20000 saved multiplicity draws and denominators without replacement resampling', 'full historical provenance bytes and 13-file model inventory retained as metadata', 'relocated six-file workflow/plan validation', 'archive member whitelist and every archived byte hash'],
    'limits': ['Old feature archive was hashed only; historical H was not decompressed.', 'Snapshot inventory is archived metadata; model weights were not loaded or newly validated by this preparation.', 'No real classifier fits, model/GPU execution, raw scores, cloud actions, network requests or installations.', 'Scientific validity and total GPU timing require the future complete supervised execution and CPU analysis.'],
    'synthetic_classifier_fits': 3, 'real_classifier_fits': 0, 'model_loads': 0, 'cloud_actions': 0,
    'hard_gpu_timeout': {'external_command': 'timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 895s', 'total_cap_seconds': 900, 'child_supervisor_receipt_required': True},
    'packaging_procedure_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'packaging_procedure_source_sha256': w.digest(__file__),
}
w.write_json(root / 'PREPARATION_PROOF.json', proof)
print(json.dumps({'payload': manifest['archive'], 'payload_members': len(files), 'uncompressed_file_bytes': manifest['uncompressed_file_bytes'], 'manifest': w.identity(root / 'PAYLOAD_MANIFEST.json'), 'proof': w.identity(root / 'PREPARATION_PROOF.json'), 'readme': proof['readme']}, indent=2))
